a_support.scope: No recalibration, no coefficient or draw discarded, no arbitrary recentering of a weak subgraph. High marginal group-SE measurements admitted only to this support sensitivity experiment; full correlated reference covariance remains. No independent-zero certification implied.

b_16_00.scope: Whole held year excluded from every target band before association. Frozen r-anchor additions and independent no-NSC-r anchor route separated; non-r r magnitudes come from actual SDSS r and are labelled. All bands eligible by physical quality; object IDs never enter training association. One-to-one 1arcsec held matches and four displaced-position controls. Conditional residuals are not absolute dark-star PM truth.
b_16_00.limitations: Candidate counts only, not adopted reliable stars. Unknown identities/blends are not successes; native W0 shared-night errors are uncalibrated. Footprints of qualified exposures do not prove a faint target had sufficient SNR. Original object-index r acquisition selection remains. No adopted full catalogue until independent source/error/zero validation.

b_16_00.scope: Fixed geometric core center, first/last actual exposure per filter. Comparison against retrieved normalized measurement identities, not source truth or image completeness. Historical ndetr/r selection can suppress non-r discoveries; zero audit losses in a few exposures do not prove general completeness.

b_16_00.coefficient_precision_note: A/D are actual float32 FITS 5E coefficients. Their half-ULP gives a possible constant great-circle-coordinate roundoff, not a target centroid error. Recentered residual is a diagnostic, not a new astrometric correction.
b_16_00.scope: Position-only reconstruction from published row/column, optical-distortion/DCR and affine coefficients; compares exact published per-band angular offsets. No proper-motion truth, no extra astrometric correction. Scalar r errors are not cloned.
b_16_00.adoption: Not approved for joint fitting yet: centroid/WCS covariance, shared-scan errors, per-band detection flags and independent held-object validation still required.
